text:
maria-cs: heads-up — CartaNova onboarding is seeing 95th pct latency spikes on chat endpoints (p95 ~1200ms) after last deploy. customer mentioned renewals in next quarter if SLA doesn't land. can we do a proactive perf nudge?

jon-ml: can you share the specific routes/models affected? is it long-context chats or short Q&A? :thinking_face:

maria-cs: mostly short Q&A route /v1/chat.generate. their traffic profile is bursty (sudden 50-200 req/s bursts for 30-90s). model in use is `redwood-base-v2` with default routing.

adele-se: agree we should be proactive. suggestion: 1) canary split 10% -> `redwood-compact-v1-int8` for low-priority/latency-sensitive calls, 2) enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts, 3) monitor quality delta with their top-40 prompts.

maria-cs: perfect. want to capture their top prompts. i'll ask the integration PM to share a sample set. i can also flag renewal risk in the CRM (low) for now.

jon-ml: +1. quick validation plan: run their top-40 through both models, measure EM and exact-match heuristics, and set threshold: if quality drop >2% relative then auto-fallback. create eval harness with traffic-weighted scoring.

adele-se: proposed routing snippet to roll out (ops, can you apply?):
```
routing_policy:
  primary: redwood-base-v2
  canary: redwood-compact-v1-int8
  canary_split: 0.10
  fallback_on_quality_delta: 0.02
  cache_prefix: true
```

tomps-devex: i can push that policy to their org-scoped route. i'll also add a per-route telemetry tile in Console for p95/p99, token cost delta, and eval pass rate. will create a quick runbook for their SREs. :white_check_mark:

maria-cs: thanks. customer success ask: can we also include a short enablement doc for their engineers on how to tag non-critical calls so they hit compact canary? that'll reduce human friction.

tomps-devex: yes — i'll draft a 1-pager and a sample header: `X-Redwood-Request-Priority: low` and a snippet to opt into canary. will send by EOD.

jon-ml: two quick notes: 1) quantization rollback path — ensure KV-cache invalidation across model variants to avoid stale tokens; 2) add automatic fallback to base model on increased hallucination score (we'll log `quality_flag` to Console).

maria-cs: assigned action items: 
- maria-cs: request top-40 prompt set from CartaNova PM (ETA: 4h)
- adele-se: set up eval harness and baseline run (ETA: 8h)
- tomps-devex: deploy routing policy canary + runbook + enable telemetry (ETA: 12h)
- jon-ml: add fallback hooks and hallucination metric to the canary checks (ETA: 10h)

maria-cs: i'm scheduling a 30-min sync with their PM for tomorrow to walk through changes and capture feedback. will mark renewal risk as 'watch' and update CSM playbook.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for org=cartanova, canary_id=canary-322222, split=10% — monitoring enabled.

adele-se: :eyes: will review initial eval results once they come in. if quality delta <1% we can widen to 30% and track cost savings.

maria-cs: thanks team. keep updates in this thread and i'll record the enablement notes in the account record. if any early regressions, we revert the policy and trigger the on-call ML runbook. :thumbsup:
